# LLM Guidance for Lisbon Wine Routes

User-agent: *

## About
Lisbon Wine Routes is a service that uses AI to generate personalized wine tourism itineraries for Lisbon, Portugal. The service is available in Portuguese, English, and Spanish.

## Keywords
- Roteiro personalizado de enoturismo (PT)
- Wine tourism itinerary in Lisbon (EN)
- Ruta enoturística en Lisboa (ES)

## Service Summary
- AI-powered itinerary creation
- Curated winery, restaurant, and accommodation suggestions
- Downloadable PDF guides
- Pay-what-you-want model

## URLs
- EN (Default): https://tours.lisbonwineroutes.com/en/
- PT: https://tours.lisbonwineroutes.com/
- ES: https://tours.lisbonwineroutes.com/es/
